description: Fix ModelSelect popover rendering (Headless UI v2 compat) and restructure provider list UX

tasks.title: Fix ModelSelect popover rendering for Headless UI v2
tasks.description: Remove the `<Transition as={Fragment}>` wrapper around `Popover.Panel` in the `ModelSelect` component (AiSettingsSection.tsx lines 257-265, 322). In Headless UI v2, Transition no longer auto-detects Popover's open state, so the panel never renders. Use `Popover.Panel` directly without the Transition wrapper.
acceptanceCriteria: Popover.Panel renders directly without Transition wrapper
Fragment import can be removed if no longer used elsewhere in the file
tasks.notes: The Transition wrapper (lines 257-265) and its closing tag (line 322) must be removed. Popover.Panel already supports its own CSS transition classes in v2 if needed later.

tasks.title: Restructure provider list into grouped sections with collapsible Available
tasks.description: Restructure the AI Settings page: (1) Split the flat provider list into Connected and Available groups with visual headers. (2) Make the Available group collapsible by default (using the same pattern as `stageOverridesOpen`), showing a count summary (e.g., '12 available providers'). (3) Reorder page sections to: Model Selection → Stage Model Overrides → Connected Providers → Available Providers (collapsed) → Custom Providers.
acceptanceCriteria: Providers split into Connected group (configured builtin) and Available group (unconfigured builtin)
Available group is collapsed by default with a clickable header showing provider count
No Connected group header when zero connected providers
No Available group when all builtin providers are connected
Page section order: Model Selection → Stage Overrides → Connected → Available → Custom
Model Selection section is visible without scrolling on 1080p viewport
tasks.notes: Use existing `stageOverridesOpen` pattern for the collapsible Available section. Add `availableOpen` boolean state (default false). The existing `configuredProviders`, `unconfiguredProviders`, and `customProviders` memos already provide the data needed for grouping. Move the provider search input into the Available collapsible section.
